deliberate_recipe_choices: Build LLVM 22.1.8 from source for llvmlite 0.49.0; do not copy LLVM runtime libraries from an SDK extension.
Build OpenCV with an isolated source-built NumPy 2.1.3 and setuptools 69.5.1 build environment, retaining NumPy 2.5.2 at runtime.
Use isolated source-built setuptools-scm 7.1.0 for python-dateutil; retain SCM 9.2.2 for current build backends.
Disable OpenCV IPP/ITT/G-API implicit downloads; validate full application behavior before acceptance.
Disable OIIO OpenColorIO and command-line tools; LightTable uses its own ICC path. This source-build feature difference requires native regression validation.
